codes.meaning: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credential.
Credential lacks the scope or library for this operation; unauthorized dependency metadata is not disclosed.
The endpoint's server_id differs from the one the client expected; credentials were not sent or content not accepted.
Client contract/API version is not supported by this server.
No such asset in an authorized library.
The exact version is missing; the current version is never substituted.
The requested representation is still being prepared; retry later.
The version offers no delivery of the requested representation.
Received or declared bytes/hashes differ from the immutable record (corruption, not an update).
Package violates the static source package grammar or ZIP safety rules.
A source dependency is unavailable, unauthorized, or not an exact supported library reference.
A size, count, depth, ratio or budget limit was exceeded.
The asset changed after checkout; expected_current_version no longer matches.
Idempotency key reused with a different request.
Client-side only: the user cancelled the operation. Servers never emit it; 499 is a local convention.
Transient server condition; retry with backoff.
The preview receipt expired and staging was cleaned; re-upload.
